China's Manufacturing Sector Shows Contraction for Second Consecutive Month

China's official manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) registered 49.8 in the latest reporting period. This figure indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, as it remains below the 50-point threshold that distinguishes growth from contraction. This marks the second consecutive month the index has fallen below this critical level, signaling ongoing challenges for the domestic economy despite a rebound in factory activity.
